question: Sardhana Christian Fair is held in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sardhana Christian Fair is a significant event held in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The fair is held in the town of Sardhana, which is located in the Meerut district of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• This fair is an important religious event for the Christian community, particularly those following the Catholic faith.
 
• The fair is held at the Basilica of Our Lady of Graces, a historical church built by Begum Samru, a notable figure in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh**

 
 
• Uttar Pradesh, often abbreviated as UP, is a state in northern India with Lucknow as its capital.
 
• It is the most populous state in India, with a rich cultural and historical heritage.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is known for its diverse religious and cultural events, including various fairs and festivals that draw people from across the country.
 
• The state is home to several important historical and religious sites, including the Taj Mahal, Varanasi, and Ayodhya.
 
 
 
• **Basilica of Our Lady of Graces**
 
 
• The Basilica of Our Lady of Graces, also known as Sardhana Church, is a prominent Catholic church located in Sardhana, Meerut.
 
• It was built by Begum Samru, a wealthy and influential figure of the 18th century, who converted to Christianity and constructed the church in 1822.
 
• The church is an architectural marvel, reflecting a blend of Indian and European styles, and is one of the most significant Christian pilgrimage sites in North India.
 
• The annual fair held at the church attracts thousands of devotees and visitors, making it a notable event in the region.
